routes.title: Pay Period Selection
routes.description: Select the pay period for payroll processing. Choose the month and year for which payroll will be calculated.

fields.name: period_month
fields.label: Month
fields.description: Select the payroll month. Must be a valid calendar month within the current or previous fiscal year.

fields.name: period_year
fields.label: Year
fields.description: The fiscal year for the pay period. Typically the current year or the previous year for retro adjustments.

routes.title: Employee Data Review
routes.description: Review employee payroll data for the selected period. Check for missing information, discrepancies, or errors before calculating payroll.

fields.name: employee_id
fields.label: Employee ID
fields.description: Unique identifier for the employee. Auto-generated but can be searched.

fields.name: department
fields.label: Department
fields.description: Filter employees by department to review specific groups.

fields.name: status
fields.label: Review Status
fields.description: Current review status of the employee's payroll data. 'Has Errors' means action is required before calculation.

routes.title: Fix Employee Data Errors
routes.description: Correct data errors flagged during the employee review step. Fix missing fields, invalid values, or discrepancies in employee records.

fields.name: employee_id
fields.label: Employee ID
fields.description: The employee whose data needs correction.

fields.name: field_name
fields.label: Field to Fix
fields.description: The specific field that has an error. Refer to the error description for details.

fields.name: corrected_value
fields.label: Corrected Value
fields.description: The corrected value for the field. Must pass all validation rules.

routes.title: Calculate Payroll
routes.description: Run the payroll calculation for the selected period. The system computes gross pay, deductions, taxes, and net pay for all reviewed employees.

fields.name: pay_period_id
fields.label: Pay Period
fields.description: The pay period to calculate. This is auto-selected from the previous step.

fields.name: include_overtime
fields.label: Include Overtime
fields.description: Whether to include overtime calculations in this run. Overtime rates are configured per department.

fields.name: include_bonus
fields.label: Include Bonuses
fields.description: Whether to include any approved bonuses in this payroll calculation.

routes.title: Payroll Preview
routes.description: Preview the calculated payroll results before confirming. Review totals by department, check for anomalies, and verify net pay amounts.

fields.name: view_type
fields.label: View
fields.description: Switch between summary view (totals by department) and detail view (individual employee breakdown).

routes.title: Request Payroll Approval
routes.description: Submit the calculated payroll for managerial approval. Required if your organization's policy mandates approval before posting.

fields.name: approver_id
fields.label: Approver
fields.description: Select the manager or finance officer who will approve this payroll run.

fields.name: notes
fields.label: Notes
fields.description: Optional notes to the approver explaining any special circumstances.

routes.title: Approval Status
routes.description: Check the status of a payroll approval request. Wait for the approver to accept or reject before proceeding.

fields.name: request_id
fields.label: Request ID
fields.description: The approval request ID from the previous step.

routes.title: Confirm and Post Payroll
routes.description: Final step: confirm the payroll and post it to the general ledger. This action is irreversible — ensure all reviews are complete.

fields.name: pay_period_id
fields.label: Pay Period
fields.description: The pay period being confirmed.

fields.name: post_to_gl
fields.label: Post to General Ledger
fields.description: Whether to automatically create GL entries for this payroll run. If false, you must post manually later.

fields.name: confirmation_code
fields.label: Confirmation Code
fields.description: Enter the confirmation code sent to your email to authorize this action.

routes.title: Generate Payroll Reports
routes.description: Generate payroll reports for the completed period. Available reports include pay slips, department summaries, and tax reports.

fields.name: report_type
fields.label: Report Type
fields.description: Select the type of report to generate. 'payslips' generates individual PDFs for each employee.

fields.name: format
fields.label: Format
fields.description: Output format for the report. PDF is recommended for payslips, CSV for bank files.

routes.title: Create Invoice
routes.description: Create a new invoice for a client. Fill in client details, line items, tax rates, and payment terms.

fields.name: client_id
fields.label: Client
fields.description: Select the client to invoice. Must be an existing client in the system.

fields.name: invoice_date
fields.label: Invoice Date
fields.description: The date on the invoice. Defaults to today.

fields.name: due_date
fields.label: Due Date
fields.description: Payment due date. Calculated based on the client's payment terms if not specified.

fields.name: payment_terms
fields.label: Payment Terms
fields.description: Net payment terms for this invoice. 'Net 30' means payment is due within 30 days.

routes.title: Invoice Preview
routes.description: Preview the invoice before sending it to the client. Verify line items, totals, and tax calculations.

routes.title: Send Invoice
routes.description: Send the invoice to the client via email or download as PDF. The invoice status changes to 'Sent'.

fields.name: delivery_method
fields.label: Delivery Method
fields.description: How to send the invoice to the client. Email sends it to the client's registered email address.
